record.one_liner: AI meeting recorder and notetaker that records, transcribes and summarizes calls
record.auth_notes: API keys are generated in the Fathom settings area and sent in the X-Api-Key header; the TypeScript and Python SDKs also show bearer auth. OAuth is available for public apps that other users install; the developer docs say OAuth apps are subject to review for marketplace promotion.
record.access_notes: Developers can generate an API key from settings and make a first call. The fetched pricing page lists a Free plan with unlimited MCP connected users. I did not confirm which plan column the Public API row belongs to, so free-plan API access is not fully verified.
record.api_notes: Documented REST API at api.fathom.ai with a rate limit of 60 calls per minute per user across all keys. Endpoints I saw included list teams and recording downloads. I did not enumerate the full endpoint set.
record.blocker_notes: Self-serve API key gives a documented REST API for own or team meetings. Only OAuth apps distributed to other users need vendor review.
